The final plan includes stable FR/NFR IDs, a full 13-area regression matrix
and the QA Summary columns in `method/ticket-to-test-plan.md`. Draft in chat,
seek design approval before finalisation; orchestrated outputs follow workflow-plan
approval, while standalone local writes have no extra L1 action gate. Summarise changes.
Publishing a page, comment or report is an independent L4 action; do not
conflate an output file with publication or claim unrun tests passed.
